notes.title: Kukumushi Virtual Pet
notes.content:
Kukumushi virtual pets are here!
Inspired by early-generation virtual pets like Tamagotchi and Giga Pet, Kukumushi are a fun new experience.
Kukumushi need care, attention and affection to survive and reach their full potential.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41310268/27fdf596d0a9ce9dbc476a7f159dcdcfe3e4539b.png[/img]

Adopt up to three Kukumushi at once. You'll be very busy taking care of them all!
Are you ready for the challenge?
Adopt your Kukumushi and let the fun begin!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1855070/Kukumushi_Virtual_Pet/

notes.title: Let's Learn Janggi (Korean Chess)
notes.content:
Learn the traditional Korean game of Janggi.
Examine all aspects of the ancient strategy game, including the Korean names of important game elements.
Learn with interactive training boards and challenge yourself with endgame puzzles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34139989/719cfa6758e8f3e93560dbe643c4e7a2d32eba0a.png[/img]

Play against a wide variety of AI opponents, choosing a difficulty to match your skill level.
In-game indicators provide helpful reminders of each piece's available movements, letting you focus on choosing the best move.
As you improve, dial up the difficulty to ensure a stimulating strategic challenge.
Try playing with a handicap to test your skills to the limit!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34139989/735992db44f68bb6fcce22d82b6e16086402d5d2.png[/img]

Once you've learned the basics, why not enter the Janggi leagues?
Choose from the Daejeon, Gwangju, Busan and Seoul leagues. Each league has a variety of AI opponents to challenge you at every level.
To progress through the leagues, you'll develop your technique and employ a wide range of Janggi tactics.
With a sound strategy, victory can be yours.

[i]Let's Learn Janggi[/i] releases on May 22nd. Wishlist it now:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1597900/Lets_Learn_Janggi/

notes.title: Let's Learn Xiangqi
notes.content:
Examine all aspects of the art of Xiangqi, learning with interactive training boards.
Study piece movements, checkmate conditions and tactics; learn Xiangqi inside out!
Practice strategic formations and techniques used by the masters of Xiangqi.
Challenge yourself with over 60 training puzzles and become an expert in endgame strategy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34139989/e8ad11c81027ed30b7624deaed306f5063b5e14a.png[/img]

Play against a wide variety of AI opponents, choosing a difficulty to match your skill level.
As you improve, you can dial up the difficulty to ensure a stimulating strategic challenge.
Try playing with a handicap, to test your strategic skills to the limit!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34139989/70bff4bea261d44a1a7a44062206bdb41805364b.png[/img]

Once you've learned the basics, why not enter the Xiangqi leagues?
Choose from the Kunming, Chengdu, Shanghai and Beijing leagues. Each league has a range of AI opponents to challenge you at every level.
To progress through the leagues, you'll develop your technique and employ a wide range of Xiangqi tactics.
With a sound strategy, victory can be yours.

[i]Let's Learn Xiangqi [/i]releases on March 17th. Wishlist it now:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1558750/Lets_Learn_Xiangqi/
